comment:overrides: zod 4.4.0 made required z.custom() keys reject undefined, which breaks nextra-theme-docs' <Layout>: it strips `children` from props before validating them against a schema that still requires `children`. Nextra 4.6.1 asks for zod ^4.1.12, so npm otherwise resolves 4.4.x and every page 500s. Remove this once Nextra fixes the schema.
